heading: Prohibition on use of funds for specified purposes

tree.heading: In general
tree.text: Cooperative Threat Reduction funds may not be obligated or expended for any of the following purposes:

children.text: Conducting any peacekeeping exercise or other peacekeeping-related activity.
Provision of assistance to promote environmental restoration.
Provision of assistance to promote job retraining.
Provision of assistance to promote defense conversion.

tree.heading: Limitation with respect to conventional weapons
tree.text: Cooperative Threat Reduction funds may not be obligated or expended for the elimination of—

children.text: delivery vehicles of conventional weapons, unless such delivery vehicles could reasonably be used or adapted to be used for the delivery of chemical, nuclear, or biological weapons.
